# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: mobile-api.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: mobile-api
  team: mobile
  tier: critical
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    latency-p95:
      target: 95.0
      window: 30d
    latency-p99:
      target: 90.0
      window: 30d
    auth-success-rate:
      target: 99.9
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: mobile-cache
    type: database
    critical: true
  - name: auth-api
    type: api
    critical: true
  - name: user-service
    type: api
    critical: true
  - name: content-api
    type: api
    critical: true
  ownership:
    team: mobile
